summary: Feature-completeness audit (findings only, no product edits). Verified: (a) evidence contract command exits 0 ('findings 16'); (b) a self-check script validates all 12 keys, the enums, unique ids, and that the summary block equals a recount; (c) every gate in the brief's tier list was EXECUTED here — 25 exit 0 (validate 0/0, check, build, pipeline 138/138, plane 10,827, plane-helper-extent 206/0, somatotopy 45/0, cortical-lobes 564/564, pip-contract, division-toggles 251/0, area-toggles 472ish exit 0, view-filter-consistency 102/102, audit-checks 92/0, closure-bite 7/7, boundary-contract 22/0, a11y-contract 38/0, budget-report, imaging-v4/-v4b, cranial-nerves 451/0, nerve-kind 79/0, cranial-nerve-courses, cranial-nerve-render 47/47, vasc-courses 2,171/0, vessel-render 75/75, build-anatomy-geometry --manifest) with tails recorded; verify:anatomy and verify:imaging-fit are exit-1 EPERM before any verdict (reported unverifiable-here, not green) and audit-facts runs 47/49 but has no npm script. Also measured: shipped vessel table is 41 courses/79 tubes vs README's 40/77; README says cranial-nerve-render is red at 46/47 while it is green at 47/47; syndrome '24 cards' vs 26; '12 plates' vs 15; zh-CN README frozen at v14; v12/v16/v18 have no README entry; explode/CSF numbers ungated. Positive finding recorded: every v2–v18 era in the brief is present in code with a named gate. Writes stayed strictly inside the two assigned files (plus gitignored .dsh-scratch/feature-audit/ probes).
